result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, which suggests the image or content did not finish loading. The other findings are minor: the time badge on the first 'Fastest near you' card looks misaligned, and some secondary text has low contrast.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in 'Popular right now'. The image appears to be stuck loading or only partly rendered, and the spinner sits on top of the food photo like a broken overlay.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the image loads and the spinner is removed once it does. Use a skeleton or placeholder while loading, and add an error or retry fallback if the load fails.

issues.description: On the 'Green Bowl Poké' card, the '15–25 min' time badge overlaps the plate illustration. The badge's left edge also sits differently against the image than on the neighboring cards, so the badges look inconsistently placed.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badges at a consistent inset from the bottom-left corner on every card, and keep them clear of the key parts of the image.

issues.description: The light gray secondary text ('€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0.00 delivery • Ramen') and the placeholder text in the search field have low contrast against the white or light gray backgrounds. The inactive tab labels have the same problem.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons sit on images with different backgrounds. The one on the ramen image is a dark translucent circle that is barely visible, and the one on the pizza card is styled differently.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite buttons the same background treatment everywhere, for example a solid white or consistently dark circle with enough contrast.
